ledger.problem: Could ANY teleost in the measured ranges sustain the real fish's flight?
ledger.description: Level flight of the Park and Choi specimen at its measured maximum lift-to-drag ratio needs 1.3473 W (W 0.5886 N at 10 m/s with L/D 4.37, the most generous reading). The question is not whether the chain's particular proxies can pay for it, but whether any teleost inside the measured ranges can.
ledger.source: physics/glide-data.csv (Park and Choi 2010 model L3) for the power required; physiology/ for the ranges
ledger.eliminationCaveat: eliminates the quantitative form given here to a source hypothesis, under the committed inputs (proxies where so labelled), not the source itself
